name: managed-fleet
description: The project the Management API is measured over. It declares an access block, so a caller can reach the surface at all; two management levels, so the write path's 'developer, not viewer' rule is measurable against one project rather than against a second fixture; two entities, so 'what is served' is a set rather than a single name; and rules that admit one declared role and refuse another, so a policy simulation has two different answers to give and can be compared against what the Data API actually answers.

audits.description: Readable by a dispatcher and writable by nobody: it declares no create, update or delete rule at all, so default-deny is what answers those. It is the entity a policy simulation can be genuinely denied for, and the only shape in this project where the engine refuses rather than handing back a predicate.
